title: Greyford — Market Night (demo)
notes: A small original demo for Cribmap. Uses the generic walled-town map and built-in letter tokens.

spend.name: Small flashback
spend.desc: Something you prepared earlier is already in place.

spend.name: Large flashback
spend.desc: A whole prepared plan pays off; play it as a short scene.

pins.title: GM: How this demo works
pins.notes: Players have 20 minutes to find out who stole the guild's ledger. Award points with the +N buttons. Reveal the crypt fog only if they find the stair under the shrine.

pins.title: Market Square
pins.notes: Stalls are packing up. A lamplighter saw someone carrying a ledger toward the shrine.

tiers.gain: Someone in a grey cloak hurried north.
The cloak had a guild clasp. It was one of their own.

pins.title: Shrine crypt (fogged)
pins.notes: The ledger is hidden behind a loose ossuary stone.

tokens.name: Oda the Lamplighter
tokens.notes:
VIBE (read aloud): A stooped woman with a long brass pole, humming as she lights the last lamps.
VOICE: Slow, kind, loses her train of thought.
KNOWS:
• Grey cloak, heading north, around the second bell.

checks.any: She thanks you and wanders off.

tiers.gain: The cloak went into the shrine, not past it.
She recognized the walk: Master Hesk, the guild treasurer.

tokens.name: Master Hesk
tokens.notes:
VIBE (read aloud): A thin man in an expensive coat, counting coins that are already counted.
VOICE: Clipped and over-polite.
KNOWS:
• He hid the ledger himself to cover his own skimming.

checks.approach: Watch him while you mention the shrine

tiers.gain: He has crypt dust on his boots.

tokens.name: The Crypt Warden
tokens.notes:
VIBE (read aloud): A cold light takes the shape of a robed figure. "Who disturbs the counted dead?"
KNOWS:
• Exactly which stone was moved.
